scope: Exact current-state inference, unrestricted full-horizon Bellman optimization without default resource limits, and two explicit greedy baselines. Exact optimizations have completed for documented ten-person four- and five-gene cases; completion at the target of 10–15 individuals and 10–15 genes remains unproved.

extraction.inference.py: Complete numerical kernel; renamed module imports, CaseDescriptor -> PedigreeCase, ArrayInferenceState -> InferenceState, ScientificSuccessInference -> PedigreeInference.
extraction.nuclear.py: Complete exact nuclear specialization; renamed model/inference imports and factory -> make_inference.
extraction.junction_tree.py: Canonical tree builder; removed unused rooted-separator partition classes and partition_for_test. Removed matching obsolete __all__ exports.
extraction.model.py: Required model fields from CaseDescriptor, standalone JSON loader, and synthetic family generator; no research metadata or external production adapter.
extraction.policies.py: Only recursive-myopic action loop and horizon-one information choice; nuclear moment shortcut and original tie tolerances retained.
extraction.__main__.py: Default exact optimization on a small case, with optimal or resource_limit JSON output; greedy trajectories require explicit selection.
extraction.checks/: Standalone correctness checks, including complete-world oracle comparisons, optional native/Python parity, API behavior and fallback; no source research-test suite or generated artifacts copied.

excluded: experimental research optimizers and policy variants beyond the documented exact solver and two baselines
all source tests and generated results
source Git history and remote configuration
private datasets, machine paths and environment files

exact_optimizer.implementation: Standalone unrestricted Bellman optimization. The nuclear solver uses exact normalized integer Mendelian likelihood signatures, cached per-gene posterior states, identical-profile gene permutations, exchangeable child actions, and analytical closure of conditionally independent remaining individuals. General pedigrees use full observation states. All legal decisions and supported outcomes are preserved; no default state, transition, or time cap. No runtime import of gt_code2 or gt_code4.
exact_optimizer.validation: Installed version 0.3.0 native optimization compared against gt_code2 solve_exact_dp_primal on all 2696 supported histories in two matched two-gene families: maximum absolute value error 2.7755575615628914e-17 and zero chosen-action regret. Both Python and compiled backends also pass independent complete-world oracle checks. Reference file hashes identify the live source, including pre-existing local changes.
exact_optimizer.not_the_reference: The named multigene dual using additive per-gene value functions is a separate upper-bound calculation and is not the unrestricted optimum used for compatibility.
exact_optimizer.resource_limits: All fields default to null (unlimited). Only explicitly supplied limits can return resource_limit; an incomplete solve returns no optimum.
exact_optimizer.native_backend: Optional C++17 execution of the same full Bellman recurrence, with capsule-owned value storage and lazy read-only queries. Missing or unloadable extension, or a state key wider than the native representation, uses the exact Python implementation with any remaining explicitly requested budget. Compiler failure does not impose an optimizer cutoff.
